label: Slack MCP (app-owned OAuth)
message: Reuse an eligible existing Slack app where its registration and redirect support this broker; a new app is not inherently required. Explicitly select none only for an existing PKCE-enabled public client. The Slack desktop-PKCE policy permits this choice even when server metadata lists only confidential methods; it does not claim none was advertised or verify this registration. Otherwise use advertised confidential authentication. Workspace approval and explicit user consent remain required. Exact MCP read schemas, verified account/workspace identity and channel-scoped search enforcement must be vetted before any tools can be granted. No Claude login or slack-axi credentials are reused.
